Hello, I’m Ali

I design brands and build games where creativity meets code.

I’m a 20-year-old student of Information Technology Management in Lahore. Through PixelCraft Digital I design social posts, presentations and documents, and under AH Studios Official I build small browser games.

My long-term goal is a career as a cyber security engineer, so I’m building those fundamentals step by step. I’m a Hafiz-e-Quran (2021), and I care about honest work and fair prices.
